# Veterinary Business Institute

> The Veterinary Business Institute (VBI) helps veterinary practice owners, hospital managers, and associate veterinarians grow through a free podcast, live webinar panels and replays, practical marketing guidance, and business education. VBI is associated with Ekwa Marketing and the Veterinary Business Podcast.

VBI's content centers on local SEO and Google Business Profile, veterinary practice growth, team retention and leadership, client experience, and marketing strategy. Most resources are free and ungated.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://www.veterinarybusinessinstitute.com/): Overview of VBI's podcast, panels, webinars, and growth support.
- [About](https://www.veterinarybusinessinstitute.com/about): VBI's mission and how its education connects podcast, webinars, and marketing.
- [Team](https://www.veterinarybusinessinstitute.com/team): The leadership and coaching team behind VBI and Ekwa Marketing.
- [Contact](https://www.veterinarybusinessinstitute.com/contact): Reach the VBI team for podcast, webinar, and partnership questions.

## Podcast & Webinars
- [The Veterinary Business Podcast](https://www.veterinarybusinessinstitute.com/podcast): Free conversations with veterinarians and industry leaders on building a thriving practice.
- [Webinars](https://www.veterinarybusinessinstitute.com/webinars): Replay-ready webinars on leadership, technology, marketing, and growth.
- [Events](https://www.veterinarybusinessinstitute.com/events): Free virtual panels and workshops, plus on-demand replays.
- [Webinar Registration](https://www.veterinarybusinessinstitute.com/webinars/registration): Register for upcoming live veterinary business webinars.
- [Featured Speakers](https://www.veterinarybusinessinstitute.com/speakers): The veterinary leaders, consultants, and practice owners featured on VBI panels and the Veterinary Business Podcast.

## Resources
- [Free Resources & Guides](https://www.veterinarybusinessinstitute.com/resources): Practice Growth Blueprint, SEO and Google Business Profile guides, social media and email templates.
- [Free Calculators & Tools](https://www.veterinarybusinessinstitute.com/resources/tools): Practice valuation, turnover cost, client lifetime value, marketing ROI, and more.
- [Blog & Insights](https://www.veterinarybusinessinstitute.com/blog): In-depth veterinary marketing and practice-growth guides.
- [Knowledge Base & FAQ](https://www.veterinarybusinessinstitute.com/resources/faq): Answers about VBI content, podcast access, and the marketing audit.

## Services
- [Free Marketing Strategy Meeting (MSM)](https://www.veterinarybusinessinstitute.com/msm): Veterinary marketing audit, local search visibility, and growth support — book a free 60-minute strategy meeting with a customised plan.
- [Coaching Services (CSM)](https://www.veterinarybusinessinstitute.com/csm): One-on-one leadership and management coaching for practice owners.
- [Community](https://www.veterinarybusinessinstitute.com/community): A free peer network for veterinary practice owners and teams.
